title: Cartan–Hadamard Isoperimetric Conjecture
exact_target:
Does every Cartan–Hadamard manifold $(M^{n+1},g)$ satisfy
$$
|\Omega|\leq n^{-(n+1)/n}\omega_{n+1}^{-1/n}|\partial\Omega|^{(n+1)/n}
$$
for every bounded sufficiently regular open set $\Omega\subset M$?
